title: Bounded-below continuity of constructible derived internal Hom
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite extension, and $X$ a scheme whose underlying topological space is Noetherian, meaning that every descending chain of closed subsets stabilizes. Let $\Lambda$ be $\underline{\mathcal O_E}$ or $\underline E$ [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], put $B=\Lambda_X=p_X^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and use the ordinary uncompleted derived category $D(\operatorname{Mod}_B)$ [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories], namely the unbounded localization of cochain complexes of $B$-modules at quasi-isomorphisms. Let $K$ be a complex with bounded cohomology constructible in the finite constant local model sense [sk-def-sfb-constructible]: its cohomology vanishes outside a finite interval, and each cohomology sheaf admits a finite constructible stratification with finite constant local models as in [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Let $I$ be a small filtered category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and let $(M_i^\bullet)_{i\in I}$ be a diagram of cochain complexes of $B$-module sheaves [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] with one common termwise lower bound $c\in\mathbf Z$: $M_i^r=0$ for all $i$ and $r<c$. Write $M=\varinjlim_iM_i^\bullet$ for the termwise sheaf colimit. Then the evaluation-induced canonical map
$$
\varinjlim_i R\mathcal Hom_B(K,M_i^\bullet)
\longrightarrow R\mathcal Hom_B(K,M)
$$
[sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom] is an isomorphism in $D(\operatorname{Mod}_B)$. On the left, filtered colimit means the exact termwise sheaf colimit of functorial complex representatives of derived internal Hom; equivalently the assertion is that the canonical maps on all cohomology sheaves are isomorphisms. It is independent of quasi-isomorphic choices of representatives. No constructibility or completeness is required of the $M_i^\bullet$.
